headlines.title: SHW Q3 deep dive: strong revenue growth meets margin pressures and cautious outlook
headlines.summary: Paint and coating manufacturer Sherwin-Williams (NYSE:SHW) reported Q3 2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.9% year on year to $6.86 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.63 per share was 1.6% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: 5 revealing analyst questions from Sherwin-Williams’s Q3 earnings call
headlines.summary: Sherwin-Williams' third quarter results were met with a negative market reaction, primarily due to weaker-than-expected profitability despite sales growth. Management attributed the robust top-line performance to continued market share gains, new account wins, and the impact of recent acquisitions. CEO Heidi Petz acknowledged that the company’s sales-to-earnings conversion fell short of internal standards, citing elevated raw material and supply chain costs as notable challenges.

headlines.title: Sherwin Williams (SHW) Stock May Trade At A Discount To Cash Flow
headlines.summary: Sherwin-Williams has given long term holders a solid run, with the share price up 40.5% over the past three years. This puts fresh attention on whether the current US$326.01 level is fully backed by the cash the business can generate. headlines.title: Evercore ISI names its top retail sector pick
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Evercore ISI has highlighted Sherwin-Williams Company as its preferred stock in the Consumer Retail Broadlines & Hardlines sector, citing the company's pricing power and market positioning as key strengths ahead of its third-quarter earnings report.

description: The Sherwin-Williams Company engages in the development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of paint, coatings, and related products to professional, industrial, commercial and retail customers. The company operates through three segments: Paint Stores Group, Consumer Brands Group, and Performance Coatings Group. The Paint Stores Group segment offers architectural paint and coatings; protective and marine products; and OEM product finishes and related products for architectural and industrial paint contractors, and do-it-yourself homeowners under the Sherwin-Williams brand. The Consumer Brands Group segment supplies a portfolio of branded and private-label architectural paints, stains, varnishes, industrial products, wood finishes products, wood preservatives, applicators, corrosion inhibitors, aerosols, caulks, and adhesives to retailers, including home centers and hardware stores, and dedicated dealers and distributors. The Performance Coatings Group segment develops and sells industrial coatings for wood finishing and general industrial applications; automotive refinish products; protective and marine coatings; coil coatings; packaging coatings; and performance-based resins and colorants. This segment serves retailers, dealers, jobbers, licensees, and other third-party distributors. The company operates in North America, South America, the Caribbean, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The Sherwin-Williams Company was founded in 1866 and is headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio.
